categories.title: Role categories
categories.description: Internship categories as they appear in Internshala URLs, for example business-development, marketing, artificial-intelligence-ai, operations. Each becomes a work-from-home listing page.

searchUrls.title: Custom listing URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Paste Internshala listing pages you have already filtered in the browser. These are used in addition to the categories above.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: internshala reads Internshala listing pages. web searches the wider web and reads official company and campus pages.

webRoles.title: Roles to search on the web
webRoles.description: Plain role names, e.g. 'business development', 'data analyst'. If empty, the categories above are used.

webLocations.title: Locations / keywords for web search
webLocations.description: Added to each web search, e.g. remote, India, Goa.

includeCampusSites.title: Also search campus websites
includeCampusSites.description: Adds searches limited to .ac.in, .edu.in and .edu sites (university and college internship pages).

maxWebUrls.title: Max web pages to read
maxWebUrls.description: Cap on search-result pages opened (plus up to 10 internship links followed from each careers page).

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Drop listings that are not work-from-home. Turn off to include on-site internships.

includeUnknownStipendWeb.title: Keep web listings with no stipend
includeUnknownStipendWeb.description: Official pages often do not state a stipend, so these are kept by default.

llmExtraction.title: Use Claude to read unusual pages
llmExtraction.description: Fallback for pages with no structured data. Needs an Anthropic API key below.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Only used if the option above is on.

minStipendPerMonth.title: Minimum stipend per month (INR)
minStipendPerMonth.description: Listings below this amount are dropped.

matchOn.title: Compare the minimum against
matchOn.description: 'min' keeps a listing only if the bottom of its stipend range meets your minimum (stricter). 'max' keeps it if the top of the range meets it.

includeUnknownStipend.title: Keep listings with no stated stipend
includeUnknownStipend.description: Off by default, since unpaid and performance-based listings are usually not what you want.

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Exclude titles containing
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Case-insensitive. Listings whose title contains any of these words are dropped.

maxPagesPerListing.title: Pages per listing
maxPagesPerListing.description: How many result pages to read for each category or URL.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to save, best-paying first.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The defaults work without a proxy for small runs.
